Ad Detection Tests

Manual Verification Instructions

  1. Load a video with known ads: Click "Load Test Video" or manually navigate to a YouTube video that has ads (pre-roll, mid-roll, etc.)
  2. Run detection: Click "Run All Tests" to start automated detection
  3. Watch for ad injection: The MutationObserver will log any ad elements as they appear
  4. Verify each ad type: Check the test results panel for each ad category
  5. Manual inspection: Open DevTools (F12) → Elements tab and search for these selectors:
    • .video-ads - Main ad container
    • .ytp-ad-module - Player ad module
    • .ytp-ad-player-overlay - Overlay ads
    • ytd-ad-slot-renderer - Ad slot renderer
    • .ytp-ad-text, .ytp-ad-skip-button, .ytp-ad-preview-container
Note: This test page uses youtube-nocookie.com embed which may not serve ads. For accurate testing, replace the iframe src with a regular youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID URL or test on actual YouTube.com with the AeroGuard extension installed. Some ad types (mid-roll, sponsored) only appear on specific videos or for non-Premium users.
